Nina (Docs): Drafting release notes for the next docs deploy. Key items: snippet path cleanups, one 404 from the embed-api anchor, and a short streaming quirk QA found. Will open the PR in ~20m.

Omar (SDK): Can you paste the missing snippet IDs? I can grep the examples and add short stubs if needed.

Nina (Docs): found two refs: `snippet:embed-async-legacy` in guides/embeddings/quickstart.md and `snippet:chat-flow-3` in tutorials/chat/step-3.md (anchor renamed). I'll include exact paths in the PR.

Pia (I18N): Noted. Our localized branches (fr/es) still reference the old anchors; I'll hold fixes until the final anchor name to avoid extra rebases.

QA-Bot: Issue #8120 filed: embed streaming may omit final token for very short prompts on canary. Attached repro.

Raj (Eng): Confirmed. Root cause: partial-chunk flush ordering on canary runtime. Fix targeted for next patch. Recommend a Known Issue entry and a workaround.

Luca (Docs): Suggested relnotes copy: "Known issue: short streaming sequences on canary models may omit the final token. Workaround: set max_tokens >= 8 or use stable models." Add repro snippet and logs.

Omar (SDK): I'll open a tiny PR to add stub snippets (TODO) so snippet-check doesn't block the relnotes PR.

Nina (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6710 - title: "Relnotes: snippet tidy, anchor redirect, streaming note" Draft includes three bullets, one-line repro example, and localization instructions with anchor `#known-issues-v1-3-0`.

QA-Bot: CI for PR #6710  docs/lint: pass, snippet-check: fail (2 unresolved refs), link-check: fail (1 404).

Omar (SDK): Stub PR #6711 merged with TODO snippets. Re-running checks.

QA-Bot: All checks passing on PR #6710 after stubs merged.

Pia (I18N): I'll rebase translations and open the i18n PR once anchor `#known-issues-v1-3-0` is live.

Nina (Docs): Added rollback contact `#eng-oncall` and a one-line rollback playbook in the relnotes. Planning to merge tomorrow 09:00 PT and post announcement after deploy.

Luca (Docs): LGTM from docs. Leave copy comments on the PR if any.

Raj (Eng): Standing by for a short canary window to validate if needed.

Nina (Docs): Merging in 10 unless objections. Thanks team! :tada:
